## About This Role

While working at the Laboratory for Autonomous and Intelligent Robotics (LAIR), I conducted research on the biomechanics of skateboarding, utilizing 3D calibration techniques to track and analyze movement in DeepLabCut. My work involved performing inverse dynamics to measure the kinematic forces exerted on joints, providing valuable insights into the physical demands of skateboarding. This research not only deepened my understanding of biomechanics but also enhanced my ability to apply advanced analytical tools to real-world applications in robotics and human movement studies.
